title: Patient Payment Plan Installment Change Signed by the Patient
content:
**Rule.** A patient may lower the installment on their own **Patient Payment Plan** by signing an installment change; the lowered installment applies from the next installment and the schedule lengthens to carry the plan balance. A lower installment a patient signs for under this rule is never below the lowest installment this rule figures and lengthens the schedule only as far as this rule lets it; a due-day change, a skip or a cancellation stays under the patient-change terms.

**When it is set.** A lowered installment is set only after the installment has been recomputed for every balance added to the plan since its last recomputation.

## Signing the change

**Capability.** The patient signs, as the patient, an installment change on their own plan that lowers the regular monthly installment to the amount given. The plan's installment is replaced by that amount and the plan's count of patient-requested installment or due-day changes goes up by one; the plan balance, status and due dates are left as they are.

**How it is invoked.** `set_requested_installment_eff91f18` is the patient's own tool: the representative unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to sign the change.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `plan_id` | the reference number of the patient's payment plan, as read to the patient by the representative from the payment plan record | plan reference number |
| `monthly_payment_usd` | the new regular monthly installment, as given to the patient by the representative | USD with 2 decimal places (cents); a plain number without a currency sign |

**Return.** A confirmation of the form "Installment change signed on plan <plan reference>: <amount> USD per month, change <n> of the plan." Receiving it means the change was signed and booked; the change number counts this change.
